packageRules.description: copr image is rebuilt from source on Dockerfile changes; pinning a digest would cause stale image regressions.

fedora major bumps only take effect when the rpm/copr images are rebuilt at release time, so a broken base image surfaces mid-release rather than in PR CI (see the fedora 40 rollback in 8184bc9). Bump manually against the release path; digest updates stay enabled.
rattler crates are tightly version-locked across the workspace; bump together.

aube crates and the standalone development tool must stay on the same release. Renovate only bumps the direct aube and aube-registry entries in Cargo.lock; the other aube-* workspace crates stay behind (aube requires them only as "2") and break the build against the new API, so refresh them all, pinned to the version Renovate selected so a newer release cannot bypass its release-age delay.

commands: cargo update -p aube -p aube-registry -p aube-codes -p aube-lockfile -p aube-settings -p aube-linker -p aube-manifest -p aube-resolver -p aube-runtime -p aube-scripts -p aube-store -p aube-util -p aube-workspace --precise {{{newVersion}}}

packageRules.description: usage crates are released together and depend on each other's internals (usage-rs 6.11.0 broke against usage-argv 6.11.1); bump them together, without the release-age delay the shared preset only waives for usage-cli and usage-lib.
Sigstore crates are versioned together; bump together.
phf runtime and codegen must stay compatible for generated baked registry maps.
decmpfs 0.1.2 fails to compile for musl targets because its FICLONE ioctl request type does not match musl libc. Hold at 0.1.0 until upstream fixes it.
